description: This file defines a React-Redux connected component for managing and displaying a list of channels in the admin console's access control policy details, including search and filter functionalities.

methods.name: searchChannelsToAdd
methods.description: Filters channels based on search term and filters, returning a map of channels to add.

methods.name: makeMapStateToProps
methods.description: Creates a memoized function to map Redux state to component props, handling channel filtering and search.

methods.name: mapDispatchToProps
methods.description: Binds action creators to dispatch for use in the component.
